?

Jeremiah 31v25 MSG
I’ll refresh tired bodies; I’ll restore tired souls.

?Many entered this New Month, This New Day extremely tired.

?Many suffer from battle fatigues, from disappointments & discouragement of previous months, hence, they lack the strength to go on..
?many have become weary because expectations have not been met.

?
You can’t afford to “throw in the towel” just because you don’t “see a light in the tunnel.”

?you can’t conclude yet.
?it’s an evil report to believe anything is impossible when the Almighty God is your Father…
✔keep believing.
✔keep the fire burning.
✔keep offering praise.
✔keep thanking Him in anticipation.
✔stand on the Word of God.
✔your case cannot be difficult for God.

?
On or before the end of this year, you will have reasons to testify in Jesus name
